directAnswer: To set up a captcha, you need to choose a captcha service, create an account, and integrate the provided code into your website's form.
summary: Setting up a captcha helps protect your website from spam and automated submissions. Follow these steps to implement it effectively.

sections.heading: Choosing a Captcha Service
sections.body: Popular captcha services include Google reCAPTCHA, hCaptcha, and FunCaptcha. Evaluate their features and select one that fits your needs.

sections.heading: Creating an Account
sections.body: Sign up for the chosen captcha service and register your website. You will receive site keys that are necessary for integration.

sections.heading: Integrating Captcha into Your Website
sections.body: Add the captcha script to your HTML form. Ensure to include the site key in the appropriate field and handle the captcha response server-side.

steps.title: Select a Captcha Service
steps.detail: Visit the website of your chosen captcha provider and review their documentation.

steps.title: Register Your Website
steps.detail: Create an account and register your website to obtain the necessary site keys.

steps.title: Add Captcha to Your Form
steps.detail: Insert the provided JavaScript snippet into your HTML and include the captcha widget in your form.

steps.title: Verify Captcha Response
steps.detail: On form submission, validate the captcha response on your server using the secret key provided by the captcha service.

faqs.question: What if my captcha is not showing up?
faqs.answer: Check if the JavaScript snippet is correctly included in your HTML and that there are no JavaScript errors in your browser's console.

faqs.question: Can I customize the appearance of the captcha?
faqs.answer: Most captcha services offer customization options. Check the documentation of your selected service for details.

faqs.question: Is captcha mobile-friendly?
faqs.answer: Yes, most modern captcha services are designed to be responsive and work well on mobile devices.

caveats: Ensure that your captcha implementation complies with accessibility standards.
Some users may have difficulty completing captchas, which could impact user experience.
